messages:
anya: quick heads-up: onboarding example for edge worker trips strict TS builds when using our esm entry.
anya: local cjs dev ok, but edge bundle (module: ESNext + moduleResolution:Bundler) fails with `TS2769 No overload matches this call` on client.fetch when passed a platform Request-like object.
anya: repro gist: simple handler `export default async function(req: Request){ await client.fetch(req) }` + tsconfig with no DOM lib.
devon: classic. overloads + differing Request types from node/@types/node vs DOM cause TS to pick the wrong signature.
sam: we added explicit overloads for Request which helped some users but now makes bundlers pick a narrow one. suggestion: collapse to a single structural generic that accepts string | RequestLike.
marco: also avoid `instanceof Request` in guards 14 fails across realms in workers. use duck-typing: check .url/.method/.headers.
lex: additional small fixes: ship a RequestLike in our types, update package tsconfig (dev dts) to include DOM lib and moduleResolution:Bundler, and add an example tsconfig in docs.
anya: plan: PR with structural signature + RequestLike + duck guards + example in /examples/edge-typing + CI types-matrix (node-cjs, node-esm, edge).
sdk-bot: created RW-8921 and added types-matrix job to CI.
anya: will open PR and ping devex for review. thanks!
